scope: Node.js state/module integration with mocked router and synthetic coordinates; no physical GPS hardware or browser UI

results.name: Starting with reliable GPS begins navigation
GPS stale transitions active navigation into signal-lost state
Location updates while GPS is stale do not change route metrics or trigger reroute
GPS error status also blocks live navigation updates
Fresh GPS fix resumes navigation and recalculates from current position
GPS failure cannot trigger off-route recalculation
Stopping navigation while GPS is lost returns to route-ready and does not auto-resume
Navigation module explicitly guards unreliable GPS before route metrics and rerouting
